events.title: Update 0.14.0 is now live
events.summary: A new patch is now live! Another big one! I have redesigned the UI with custom models and elements, added a first-person view and you can now actually play as any hero you want!Please let me know what you think over on the Discord server.New:Hero View: Click the eye on a hero's card (or press F) to see the dungeon through their eyes, in first person. events.title: Update 0.9.1 is now live
events.summary: A big art update! I've spent a lot of time on this, and everything new you'll meet below was made from scratch for Dungeoneers Idle instead of coming from an asset pack.New:Goblins have moved in! A whole new enemy family made just for this game, mostly found in caves: scrappy little goblins with daggers and bows, Hobgoblin brutes and shamans, and a Goblin King wearing a crown he definitely stole.Something huge has been spotted deep in the dungeons, and those who saw it only say the ground shook.
